_doc: Epeiste puppet. Points are in sheet pixels; the model space IS the sheet space (head, torso and skirt are already in place there). 'seed' = a point inside the piece, 'cut' = keep only rows above/below y (head and torso touch), 'pivot' = joint inside the piece, 'at' = where that joint sits on the assembled body. 'mirror': true also makes the right-side twin (sheet mirrored around 'axis'). Higher z draws on top.
